mapper.insert: INSERT INTO host_vuln_result ( tenant_id, task_id, host_id, rule_id, severity, vuln_name, product_name, product_version, suggestion, status, verify_status, evidence_json, created_at ) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), 0, #{hostId}, #{ruleId}, #{severity}, #{vulnName}, #{productName}, #{productVersion}, #{suggestion}, #{status}, #{verifyStatus}, #{evidenceJson}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE host_vuln_result SET status = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, host_id, rule_id, severity, vuln_name, product_name, product_version, suggestion, status, verify_status, evidence_json, created_at, updated_at FROM host_vuln_result WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 ORDER BY CASE LOWER(severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, tenant_id, host_id, rule_id, severity, vuln_name, product_name, product_version, suggestion, status, verify_status, evidence_json, created_at, updated_at FROM host_vuln_result WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 ORDER BY CASE LOWER(severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS critical_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS high_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS medium_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS low_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING') THEN 1 END) AS verified_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'FIXED' THEN 1 END) AS fixed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS ignored_count FROM host_vuln_result

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS critical_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS high_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS medium_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS low_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING') THEN 1 END) AS verified_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'FIXED' THEN 1 END) AS fixed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS ignored_count FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT h.id AS host_id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, h.status AS host_status, CASE MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'unknown' END AS highest_severity, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS total_vuln_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFYING', 'VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') AND hvr.rule_id > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pending_rule_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING') THEN 1 END) AS verified_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'FIXED' THEN 1 END) AS fixed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS ignored_count, MAX(COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at)) AS latest_scan_time FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id WHERE hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 GROUP BY h.id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, h.status HAVING total_vuln_count > 0 ORDER BY MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, pending_count DESC, total_vuln_count DESC, latest_scan_time DESC

SELECT h.id AS host_id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, h.status AS host_status, CASE MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'unknown' END AS highest_severity, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS total_vuln_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFYING', 'VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') AND hvr.rule_id > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pending_rule_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING') THEN 1 END) AS verified_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'FIXED' THEN 1 END) AS fixed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS ignored_count, MAX(COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at)) AS latest_scan_time FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE hvr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 GROUP BY h.id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, h.status HAVING total_vuln_count > 0 ORDER BY MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, pending_count DESC, total_vuln_count DESC, latest_scan_time DESC

SELECT hvr.rule_id, MAX(vr.rule_code) AS rule_code, MAX(vr.cve_id) AS cve_id, MAX(hvr.severity) AS severity, MAX(hvr.vuln_name) AS title, MAX(vr.description) AS description, MAX(vr.product_type) AS product_type, MAX(vr.product_name) AS product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 THEN hvr.host_id END) AS total_host_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('FIXED', 'NOT_AFFECTED') THEN 1 END) AS fixed_count, MAX(COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at)) AS latest_updated_at FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN vuln_rule vr ON vr.id = hvr.rule_id WHERE hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 AND hvr.status = 1 GROUP BY hvr.rule_id HAVING total_host_count > 0 ORDER BY MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, pending_count DESC, verifying_count DESC, repair_count DESC, total_host_count DESC, latest_updated_at DESC

SELECT hvr.rule_id, MAX(vr.rule_code) AS rule_code, MAX(vr.cve_id) AS cve_id, MAX(hvr.severity) AS severity, MAX(hvr.vuln_name) AS title, MAX(vr.description) AS description, MAX(vr.product_type) AS product_type, MAX(vr.product_name) AS product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 THEN hvr.host_id END) AS total_host_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('FIXED', 'NOT_AFFECTED') THEN 1 END) AS fixed_count, MAX(COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at)) AS latest_updated_at FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN vuln_rule vr ON vr.id = hvr.rule_id WHERE hvr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 AND hvr.status = 1 GROUP BY hvr.rule_id HAVING total_host_count > 0 ORDER BY MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, pending_count DESC, verifying_count DESC, repair_count DESC, total_host_count DESC, latest_updated_at DESC

SELECT hvr.id AS result_id, h.id AS host_id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, hvr.verify_status, hvr.status, hvr.product_name, hvr.product_version FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id WHERE hvr.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND hvr.status = 1 AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 ORDER BY CASE UPPER(hvr.verify_status) WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'VERIFYING' THEN 2 WHEN 'VERIFIED' THEN 3 WHEN 'REPAIR_PENDING' THEN 4 WHEN 'TO_FIX' THEN 4 WHEN 'NOT_AFFECTED' THEN 5 WHEN 'FIXED' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END ASC, hvr.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE host_vuln_result SET verify_status = 'REPAIR_PENDING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND UPPER(verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX')

UPDATE host_vuln_result SET verify_status = 'REPAIR_PENDING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND UPPER(verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'NOT_AFFECTED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX')

UPDATE host_vuln_result SET verify_status = 'FIXED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE UPPER(verify_status) = 'REPAIR_PENDING' AND status = 1 AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{thresholdSeconds} SECOND)
AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE host_vuln_result SET verify_status = #{toStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE UPPER(verify_status) = UPPER(#{fromStatus}) AND status = 1 AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{thresholdSeconds} SECOND)
AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(grouped.result_id) AS result_id, grouped.result_ids_csv, grouped.host_id, grouped.hostname, grouped.ipv4, grouped.mac_address, grouped.os_name, grouped.os_version, grouped.verify_status, grouped.status, grouped.product_name, grouped.product_version, grouped.matched_item_count, grouped.matched_item_summary FROM ( SELECT MAX(hvr.id) AS result_id, GROUP_CONCAT(hvr.id ORDER BY hvr.id DESC) AS result_ids_csv, h.id AS host_id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'VERIFYING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('VERIFIED', 'REPAIR_PENDING', 'TO_FIX') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REPAIR_PENDING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) IN ('FIXED', 'NOT_AFFECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'FIXED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS verify_status, MAX(hvr.status) AS status, MAX(hvr.product_name) AS product_name, MAX(hvr.product_version) AS product_version, COUNT(*) AS matched_item_count, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(hvr.product_version, ''), '') = '' THEN hvr.product_name ELSE CONCAT(hvr.product_name, ' ', hvr.product_version) END ORDER BY hvr.product_name, hvr.product_version SEPARATOR ' | ' ) AS matched_item_summary FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE hvr.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND hvr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hvr.status = 1 AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 GROUP BY h.id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version ) grouped GROUP BY grouped.host_id, grouped.hostname, grouped.ipv4, grouped.mac_address, grouped.os_name, grouped.os_version, grouped.result_ids_csv, grouped.verify_status, grouped.status, grouped.product_name, grouped.product_version, grouped.matched_item_count, grouped.matched_item_summary ORDER BY CASE UPPER(grouped.verify_status) WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'VERIFYING' THEN 2 WHEN 'REPAIR_PENDING' THEN 3 WHEN 'TO_FIX' THEN 3 WHEN 'VERIFIED' THEN 4 WHEN 'NOT_AFFECTED' THEN 5 WHEN 'FIXED' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END ASC, grouped.matched_item_count DESC, grouped.result_id DESC
